message: The value of idname must be unique when panel = FALSE. Repeated cross sections treat each observation as a distinct sampling unit, but some values of 'id' appear in more than one row. If the same units are observed in multiple periods, use panel = TRUE (with allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE if the panel is incomplete). If the data are genuine repeated cross sections, give each observation its own unique value of 'id' (or omit idname).
